description: Search one course by keyword across pages, assignments, announcements and discussions (titles and bodies). Read-only. Works at every school, unlike smart_search. Use grep_all_courses when you don't know the course.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

title: Search Course Content
